solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Shell makes vehicle fast!

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
apace means quickly, at speed

explanation.surface: An exclamation that some shell or casing turns a vehicle into a speedy one.
explanation.definitionFit: A carapace is the hard upper covering of a tortoise or crab, a kind of shell.

clue.text: Convert a little currency

definitions.meaning: to convert is to alter or transform something
coins of small value, the loose cash in a pocket

explanation.definitionFit: To change is to convert; change is also small coins.

clue.text: Remember to get together again

definitions.meaning: to gather once more, read as re-plus-collect

explanation.definitionFit: Recollect means recall; split as re-collect it means gather a second time.

clue.text: Go on with most of the takings

indicators.note: most of says the word loses its final letter here

parts.note: proceeds are the money taken in from a sale or event

explanation.surface: Advice to carry on using the bulk of the money collected.
explanation.definitionFit: To proceed is to continue or go forward with something.

clue.text: Retiring copper's first to get comfortable

indicators.note: first places the copper symbol at the front, before the other piece

parts.note: CU is the chemical symbol for copper
a retiring person is shy and reserved

explanation.surface: A policeman about to retire is the first to land an easy berth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman but here it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushy job or life is an easy, comfortable one.

clue.text: Crumbs collected by school char

indicators.note: collected by means held inside the school abbreviation

parts.note: crumbs and cor are both British exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: Bread crumbs being gathered up by a school cleaning lady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crumbs' and 'char' paint a picture of breadcrumbs and a cleaner (a char is a British cleaning woman); both are misdirection, and 'char' means burn.
explanation.definitionFit: To char is to burn the surface, which is to scorch.

clue.text: Top-quality Brussels?

definitions.meaning: Brussels is the chief city of Belgium, the seat of government

explanation.definitionFit: Capital means excellent in old-fashioned British speech, and Brussels is a national capital city.

clue.text: Partly for appearance, Boris hired a Hindu poet

indicators.note: partly for appearance says only part of the following words is shown, a run within them

explanation.surface: A political figure hiring an Indian poet just for show.
explanation.definitionFit: A rishi is a Hindu sage or inspired poet of the Vedic hymns.

clue.text: Flew from the Andes?

indicators.note: from signals the answer is made out of the following letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A question about flying out of the South American mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' indicates the letters of THE ANDES are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Flew in the sense of rushed or hurried, not travelling by air.

clue.text: Savage slurs they endlessly spread

indicators.note: spread says the letters are scattered and laid out afresh
endlessly says the last letter of the word they is dropped

explanation.surface: Vicious insults that some people circulate without end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts THEY to THE; 'spread' rearranges SLURS THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruthless, without pity, is a synonym of savage as an adjective.

clue.text: Not getting one another ready to vote?

definitions.text: Not getting one another ready to vote?

parts.words: Not getting one another ready to vote?
parts.note: people misunderstanding each other; jokingly, voters holding pens to mark crosses on ballots

explanation.definitionFit: Being at cross purposes means misunderstanding each other; a voter marks a ballot with a cross.

clue.text: Covered walk right inside vessel

indicators.note: inside places the letter for right within the ship

parts.note: a galley is a type of ship

explanation.surface: A roofed walkway placed right inside a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallery can be a long covered passage or walkway, often open at one side.

clue.text: Direct link with the equator?

definitions.meaning: a dedicated telephone line between leaders
a line round the hottest part of the globe

explanation.definitionFit: A hotline is a direct phone link; the equator is a line in hot climes.

clue.text: Each had modified energy splitter

indicators.note: modified means the letters are changed into a new order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Every person had altered the energy of a splitting device.
explanation.walkthrough: A splitting headache is a severe one, so 'splitter' is a playful name for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A headache is jokingly something that splits the head, as in a splitting headache.

clue.text: Banker in Cambridge has set off short distance for something in car

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge; a river has banks, so it is a banker

indicators.note: set off says the letters are disturbed and rearranged

parts.note: FT, a foot, is a short distance, also its abbreviation

explanation.surface: A Cambridge financier setting off a short way to fetch a car part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banker' is a river (it has banks), here the CAM; 'set off' rearranges HAS to SHA.
explanation.definitionFit: A camshaft is a rotating shaft in an engine, so it is a component found in a car.

clue.text: Lake and river insect

parts.note: the Ouse is a river in England

explanation.surface: Lakes and rivers as habitats for insects.
explanation.definitionFit: A louse is a small wingless parasitic insect.

clue.text: The unclad eccentric opened the door

indicators.note: eccentric means odd, signalling that the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange naked person answered the door.
explanation.definitionFit: To unlatch is to release the catch, which opens a door.

clue.text: Woman in Italian island being held up, appealing

indicators.note: in places the girl's name within the island
held up in a down clue means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: Elba is an Italian island
Dora is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman detained on an Italian island charms everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'held up' means read upwards; 'in' puts the woman inside, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable means lovable and charming, which is appealing.

clue.text: Wife and a drink gives one such courage

definitions.text: a drink gives one such courage
definitions.meaning: alcohol gives the bravery known as ... courage

explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney slang 'my old dutch' means my wife; Dutch courage is boldness from drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Dutch is London slang for wife; Dutch courage is drink-induced bravery.

clue.text: Obstinate in gruelling part of court battle?

parts.note: hard means demanding, gruelling
a set is a division of a tennis match, played on a court

explanation.surface: Stubbornness in a tough stage of a legal fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court battle' suggests a lawsuit but is a tennis match.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard-set means fixed and rigid in attitude, stubborn.

clue.text: Mix up letters, fail to deliver with charm?

parts.note: to miss is to fail to hit or deliver
a spell is a magic charm

explanation.surface: Muddled letters, an undelivered post and a magic charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' suggests post, but here means the letters of words.
explanation.definitionFit: To misspell is to write a word's letters wrongly, getting them mixed up.

clue.text: Get ready, shave beforehand?

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before or in advance
to pare is to shave or trim off

explanation.surface: Advice to shave early when preparing to go out.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: making things ready in advance, as a cook does before a meal.

clue.text: Cross dishy bride's holding

indicators.note: holding says the answer is contained within the following words

explanation.surface: An attractive bride's possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: A hybrid is a cross between two breeds or species.

clue.text: Revitalised Britisher is out for spiritual enlightenment

indicators.note: revitalised means given new form, so the remaining letters are reworked
out says the word is is removed from the longer word

explanation.surface: A rejuvenated Briton leaves in search of spiritual awakening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is out' removes IS from BRITISHER, leaving BRITHER; 'Revitalised' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebirth in a spiritual sense is being born again, a religious awakening.

clue.text: Grilled like soldiers? Yet arresting sailors

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so one piece is captured inside the other

parts.note: but and yet both mean however
RN is the Royal Navy, sailors

explanation.surface: Soldiers questioned harshly while holding some sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: Soldiers are strips of toast in Britain, which can be grilled; burnt toast is the joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Toast soldiers that are overgrilled are burnt, charred black.

clue.text: Disheartened, never to return and attempt coming in again

indicators.note: to return means read the word backwards
disheartened means losing the heart, the central letter

parts.note: a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: A dejected person vowing never to return yet trying to get back in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' takes V from NEVER, leaving NEER; 'to return' reverses that to REEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Re-entry is the act of entering again, as a spacecraft does.

clue.text: Annoy fellow inside with firearm

indicators.note: inside means one piece is placed into the other

parts.note: to rile is to annoy

explanation.surface: A man inside annoying people with a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a long-barrelled gun.

clue.text: Phoney bids for a deed against that woman and similar people

indicators.note: phoney means fake, so the letters are falsely rearranged

parts.note: a feat is a deed
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: Fake offers for a property document set against a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Phoney' rearranges BIDS FOR A to BIRDSOFA; 'against' just places the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds of a feather are people alike in tastes, as in the proverb about flocking together.

clue.text: Eastern country's landed property

parts.note: a state is a country

explanation.surface: An eastern nation's land holdings.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a large area of land in the countryside owned by one person.

clue.text: What some footballers did — nurtured backs and made final

indicators.note: backs means the word goes back, reading in reverse

parts.note: fed means nourished or nurtured
ended means brought to a conclusion

explanation.surface: Footballers were raised as full-backs and made the cup final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backs' looks like football positions; it reverses FED to DEF.
explanation.definitionFit: Defenders in football defend, so what they did was guard their goal.
